## Methods

```{r table-data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- data.frame(
  Type = c("Exposure", "Exposure", "Outcome"),
  Data = c("Public safety power shutoff (PSPS) data, PSE", 
           "Wildfire PM<sub>2.5</sub> data, Aguilera et al. 2023 Environ Int", 
           "Hospital and emergency department data, Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)"),
  Coverage = c("Event, circuit-level data from the three major utility providers in CA (PGE, SDG&E, SCE)",
               "Daily, zip code-level",
               "Daily, zip-code level visits"),
  Years = c("2013-2022", "2006 -- 2020", "2013-2019")
)

kable(data, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#0f7ba2", color = "white", 
                font_size = 26) %>%
  row_spec(1:nrow(data), font_size = 20) %>%  # Set font size for data rows
  column_spec(1:4, border_left = FALSE, border_right = FALSE)
```

<br> 

- **Study population**: Adults (18+) in California
- **Study period**: 2013-2019
- **Study design**: Time-stratified case-crossover design
- **Statistical analysis**: Conditional logistic regression
